2.name: Stamina Tablet
2.description: Prevents stamina reduction for 10 seconds. If stamina is zero, a small amount is restored.

3.name: Sprint Shoes
3.description: Summons a quick burst of speed.

4.name: Choco Aether
4.description: Allows a previously used race ability to be executed again.

5.name: Bacchus's Water
5.description: Sends the forerunning chocobo into a Frenzied state.

6.name: Graviball
6.description: Afflicts the forerunning chocobo with Heavy.

7.name: Briar Caltrop
7.description: Surrounds your chocobo with a ring of thorns which will sap the stamina of any chocobos that enter.

8.name: Hero Tonic
8.description: Invigorates your chocobo for 15 seconds, increasing its overall performance while nullifying any enfeeblements.

9.name: Choco Meteor
9.description: Summons a meteor from the heavens to wreak havoc on all other chocobos.

10.name: Stamina Swapper
10.description: Interchanges your chocobo's stamina with that of a forerunning chocobo. Swap is made only if the forerunning chocobo has more stamina than yours.

11.name: Spiderweb
11.description: Renders the chocobo running immediately behind you unable to use items.
